svg.title: AuraProj daily change reference for 2026-07-21
svg.desc: Data-driven LMB skill and BungeeMan weapon detachment.
svg.text: 2026-07-21 - Data-driven LMB skill and weapon detachment
main | 1 commit: 9811b80
Daily job
Let role data select the basic attack instead of hard-coding the Aura staff path.
RoleConfig, RoleInfo, ability-system library, and character-base ability setup form one path.
BEFORE
LMB tied to one weapon path
Character base assumed the Aura staff.
BungeeMan inherited staff-specific behavior.
Changing basic attack required code edits.
Role data did not own the LMB choice.
AFTER
Role-selected basic attack
Role configuration carries the LMB skill and related fields.
Character base reads the selected skill from RoleInfo.
BungeeMan is detached from the Aura staff-specific LMB path.
Future LMB changes begin in role data rather than a character branch.
Guard: data selects the skill; runtime code executes it.
Important guard
Do not restore a staff-specific assumption
when adding another role. Update RoleConfig
and the typed RoleInfo contract.
Validation / newcomer path
Trace RoleConfig.json -> RoleInfo -> CharacterBase.
The LMB choice is data-driven even when the
current role still selects a familiar skill.
